summary:
Reviewed w211's fix loop: 025433c3 and 4618d2d7 (the same content as the results' 7b3f8f29 and cb1aaaef, rebased at the merge). They touch only scripts/workqueue_request.py.
No test removed or weakened, no features/ change, and no allowances claimed. tools check: ruff, vulture and import-linter clean. tools size: nothing over 300.
Finding 1 (Important, fix now): the ruling says to apply r34's side check to every command that writes a part. reply was not given one, so the upstream still writes the asker's answers on another context's request (probe: reply written). This conflicts with the capability's Implementation (the asker writes through the upstream's work) and leaves q13 and q14 with no way to answer until w212, so the person must choose.
Finding 2 (Important, observation): an internal request with only --thread in a repository that lists upstreams passes the gate but is then refused every outcome, ask and resolve (probe). A request should name its upstream; this needs a line.
The ask and resolve refusals have no scenario rows.
questions: Important, scripts/workqueue_request.py:172-178: reply has no r34 side check (the ruling named reply, and turn), so the upstream still writes the asker's answers on a request from another context. Refusing it leaves q13 and q14 with no way to answer until w212: refuse now, or narrow r34 or the ruling?
